apoli.config.title: Apoli Settings
apoli.config.speech_to_action.tooltip: Lets apoli:action_on_speech powers listen to your microphone. Off by default; nothing is recorded or sent anywhere until you turn this on.
apoli.config.speech_push_to_talk.tooltip: On: only listen while the "Speech to Action" key is held. Off: listen continuously.
apoli.config.speech_instant.tooltip: On: fire as soon as a trigger phrase is recognised. Off: wait until you finish the sentence.
apoli.config.speech_echo.tooltip: Print what was heard into chat. Useful for working out why a trigger phrase is not matching.
apoli.config.speech_source.tooltip: Where speech is captured from. Auto uses Simple Voice Chat when it is installed, otherwise the microphone directly.
apoli.config.speech_input_device.tooltip: Name of the microphone to capture from. Leave blank for the system default; the usable names are listed in the log when capture fails.
